thesisState.summary: AAPL Corp (AAPL) is evaluated with an overall 25 risk profile and intrinsic fair value of 180 USD.
thesisState.bullCase: Expansion in operating cash flows and margin stability supports fundamental outperformance.
thesisState.baseCase: Base-case intrinsic valuation evaluated at 180 USD (grounded valuation). Solvency and operating cash flows remain within historical ranges.
thesisState.bearCase: Deterioration in operating margins or emergence of cash flow divergence would impair fair value realizations.

keyDrivers.claim: DCF intrinsic fair value calculated at 180 USD based on 5-year discrete cash flow projections.

catalystState.description: Operating Moat & Pricing Power: Robust operating margin of 30.0% provides structural earnings insulation against inflation and cost pressures.

thesisBreakerState.trigger: Operating Margin Deterioration below 27%
thesisBreakerState.impact: Erosion of operating margin cushion would reduce forward free cash flow generation and lower DCF fair value.

thesisBreakerState.trigger: Balance Sheet Leverage Spike (Net Debt / EBITDA > 3.5x)
thesisBreakerState.impact: Elevated debt service burden would restrict capital allocation flexibility and elevate financial solvency risk.

thesisBreakerState.trigger: Cash Flow Divergence (Operating Cash Flow falling below Net Income)
thesisBreakerState.impact: Accumulation of uncollected non-cash receivables or accruals signals deteriorating earnings quality.

thesisBreakerState.trigger: Market Price Appreciation Eliminating Margin of Safety ($180)
thesisBreakerState.impact: Price surpassing intrinsic fair value removes margin of safety and triggers a downgrade to HOLD or WATCH.
